name: Greek Gods
overview: Scripture reveals the supremacy of the one true God over all false deities, including the Greek gods, emphasizing that the LORD is the living and everlasting King whose power causes the earth to tremble (Jeremiah 10:10). The knowledge and wisdom given by God surpass any human or spiritual authority, as demonstrated in Daniel's understanding of visions (Daniel 1:17). The New Testament further affirms the authority of Jesus Christ over evil spirits, who recognize Him but dismiss other spiritual claims (Acts 19:15). Additionally, God's existence and moral law are evident to all people by nature, showing that no culture or belief system, including those worshipping Greek gods, can claim ignorance of the true God (Romans 1:19; Romans 2:14).
